_comment: Declared PK/FK/UNIQUE overlay for the crm Postgres source (RSA apply_key_overlay). The live schema declares ZERO foreign keys and references the natural business key (account_id), not the surrogate PK (accounts.id) — RSA's FK inference only targets PKs (filed upstream), so until that release these keys are declared here. Verified against cdf-ontop-postgres-1: uniqueness on the one side, full containment on the many side, for every key below. Overlaid keys surface as enforced=False with overlay:-prefixed constraint names, so they stay distinguishable from source-declared ones. When RSA's inference fix lands, prefer `r2g source infer-fks --accept` and delete this file.
